name: Voice messages
description: Telegram-style voice messages: hold to record, release to send, with automatic transcripts.

settings_schema.header: Speech-to-text runs on Amazon Bedrock (Voxtral). Leave the AWS keys empty to use the AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variables of the Mattermost server. Grant the key bedrock:InvokeModel on the model only.

settings.help_text: Transcribes while recording and writes the transcript into the message, so mobile users see it too.
Bedrock region that serves the model. Voxtral works in eu-west-1 (Ireland).
Helps the model with short clips. It still transcribes other languages as spoken and never translates. Leave empty for no hint.
